asset_source_locator_present.name: asset_source_locator_present
asset_source_locator_present.value:
("asset"."source_type" = 'upload' AND "asset"."object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "asset"."source_url" IS NULL)
        OR ("asset"."source_type" IN ('webpage', 'youtube') AND "asset"."source_url" IS NOT NULL AND "asset"."object_key" IS NULL)

chat_run_terminal_finished.name: chat_run_terminal_finished
chat_run_terminal_finished.value: "chat_run"."status" NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'failed', 'reconciliation_required') OR "chat_run"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

ingestion_attempt_terminal_finished.name: ingestion_attempt_terminal_finished
ingestion_attempt_terminal_finished.value: "ingestion_attempt"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled') OR "ingestion_attempt"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

ingestion_job_terminal_finished.name: ingestion_job_terminal_finished
ingestion_job_terminal_finished.value: "ingestion_job"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled') OR "ingestion_job"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

node_geometry_finite_bounds.name: node_geometry_finite_bounds
node_geometry_finite_bounds.value:
"node"."x" BETWEEN -1000000 AND 1000000 AND
      "node"."y" BETWEEN -1000000 AND 1000000 AND
      "node"."width" BETWEEN 80 AND 4000 AND
      "node"."height" BETWEEN 60 AND 4000
